Click ▭ Capture region, drag around a plat's curve table. Tesseract eng_best will OCR it; each row will be math-verified against the standard formulas (L = R·Δ_rad, T = R·tan(Δ/2), C = 2R·sin(Δ/2), M = R·(1−cos(Δ/2)), E = R·(sec(Δ/2)−1)). Mismatches beyond tolerance are flagged red.

Firm Config

Stored locally in this browser only. Templates and title blocks auto-fill any field whose id matches one of these keys (firm_name, firm_addr, pls_name, pls_number, etc.).

Place a stamp

Pick a stamp, then click anywhere on the PDF to place it. Drag to reposition before save.

Markups list

PgKindDetailQtyColorStatusNote
Click a row to jump to it. Status and notes stay with the markup for this session and export in the CSV; they are not printed on the PDF.

Layers

The PDF's own layers (CAD layers exported as optional content). Hiding one affects the screen, Fill area and Find matches only — the saved PDF keeps every layer.

Slip-sheet revised pages

Replace pages of the open document with pages from a revised PDF. Your markups go with the OLD pages. The result saves as a new file; the open document is not changed.

none
keep replaced pages at the back, stamped SUPERSEDED
link "SHEET n" references to page n

Batch stamp

Same stamp on every selected PDF. Each file saves as name_STAMP.pdf; originals are untouched. Digitally-signed PDFs are skipped (stamping would void the signature). Stamps only — seals are applied one document at a time in Sign.

none

Add training sample

Crop captured. Type the exact text shown in the image (use newlines if it's multiple lines).

Lands as line-NNN.png + line-NNN.gt.txt in the export zip. Ctrl-Enter = Save · Esc = Discard.

DeepSeek API key

Stored locally in this browser only (localStorage). DeepSeek-R1 is used as a reasoning post-corrector for OCR text — it understands surveyor formats (bearings, PLSS, monument descriptions) and fixes mis-reads. ~$0.0005 per page typically.

DeepSeek's API is text-only — the cursive itself is read by the local Florence-2 / TrOCR / Tesseract engine. DeepSeek then cleans up the result.

Leave blank to remove the key. Set OCR engine + check "DeepSeek fix" to use it.

Import deed from EZ PZ

Reads localStorage.ez_current_job written by EZ PZ. If EZ PZ isn't running on this browser, paste the traverse JSON below to test. After importing, click on the map to anchor the first traverse point.

Checking ez_current_job…
Paste traverse JSON (fallback when EZ PZ isn't writing)

Shape: { job_number, client_name, traverse: { label, points: [{calc, n, e}, ...] } }. Coordinates are in feet, local origin, +N = up, +E = right.
